# WASI SHAH / 峻山 — Digital World Portfolio

> Filmmaker, motion designer, graphic designer and creative developer based in Hong Kong. Film, motion, design, 3D and AI.

## Pages
- [Home / World](https://wasi-shah-portfolio.vercel.app/): A 3D spatial portfolio with an interactive space world, blackhole, and five rooms (World, Lab, Archive, Films, Connect).
- [Privacy Policy](https://wasi-shah-portfolio.vercel.app/privacy): How personal data and cookies are handled.

## About
Syed Wasi Shah (峻山) is a video editor, motion designer and graphic designer based in Hong Kong, studying Computer Science at Hong Kong Metropolitan University (HKMU). He cuts films, designs brand systems, and builds interactive tools.

Skills: Premiere Pro, After Effects, Photoshop, Illustrator, Python, Blender, ComfyUI, CrewAI, Three.js, React.

Experience: Adobe Ambassador (Behance Co), Marketing & Teacher (Virtual Academy International), Creative Intern APAC (moji Corporation), Graphic Trainee (Seaman Paper Asia).
